objective: Build a deterministic market-language vocabulary census (scripts/analysis/market_language_census.py) that walks the five authority files plus trade sources and emits the S1..S8 taxonomy (feature schema, four distinct state vocabularies, hierarchy, trade schema, traceable ontology, exact + concept-token overlaps, orphans, canonical vocabulary table). This is the deterministic-first foundation for the Run/Trace identity design: field names downstream follow from the canonical vocabulary, and the four state vocabularies (crt_machine / feature_enum / smc_choch / trade_execution) are kept separate, never merged.

unknowns.detail: tests/test_script_registry.py has 3 failures on this branch BEFORE this change (17-38 unregistered/unclassified on-disk scripts -- layer_trace/*, live_alert_*, ultron_sem_r_shadow.py, phase1_shadow_*, grandfather-pin drift vs stubs). The census script adds one entry to the unregistered list but does not cause the failure; declaring this change COMPLETE is therefore dishonest until the unrelated WIP scripts are registered + the grandfather pin is re-synced (a separate, out-of-scope change).

rollback_boundary: Single commit: revert scripts/analysis/market_language_census.py + the seed overlay block in scripts/governance/seed_script_registry.py + the two report files together. Removing the overlay restores the SITS overlay list; re-running seed_script_registry.py re-derives data/script_registry.jsonl deterministically.
